page.title: Disease Check
page.description: Take a photo of one leaf to check it for disease.
page.noFarmDescription: Select or create a farm to start a Disease Check.

cropSelect.question: Which crop is this leaf from?

flow.previewAlt: Preview of the selected leaf photo
flow.checkingDescription: This can take up to a minute. Please keep this page open.
flow.analyzingDetectedCrop: Working out the crop from the photo

results.uncertainDescription: It may be one of the results below. Retake the photo in good light, close to one leaf, to confirm.

warnings.BLURRY_IMAGE: The photo looks blurry. Hold the phone steady and tap to focus on the leaf.
warnings.LOW_LIGHT: The photo is too dark. Take it in daylight.
warnings.OVEREXPOSED: The photo is too bright. Avoid direct sunlight on the leaf.
warnings.CROP_MISMATCH: The leaf may not belong to the crop you selected.
